# Lateness at renewal --------------------------------------------------------
# A book due Monday 23 March, renewed late, is fined as if it came back that day.


def test_renewing_on_saturday_28_march_charges_five_late_days(service, clock):
    loan = service.checkout("ann", "B1")
    clock.set(date(2026, 3, 28))  # Saturday: Late days 24 to 28 March
    renewed = service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("1.25")
    assert renewed.due_on == date(2026, 4, 18)  # Saturday
    assert renewed.renewals == 1


def test_sunday_is_not_a_late_day_at_renewal(service, clock):
    loan = service.checkout("ann", "B1")
    clock.set(date(2026, 3, 30))  # Monday: 24 to 28 and 30 March, not Sunday 29
    renewed = service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("1.50")
    assert renewed.due_on == date(2026, 4, 20)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("day", [date(2026, 3, 18), date(2026, 3, 23)])
def test_renewing_on_or_before_the_due_date_charges_nothing(service, clock, day):
    loan = service.checkout("ann", "B1")
    clock.set(day)
    assert service.renew(loan.loan_id).renewals == 1
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("0.00")


def test_a_child_renewing_an_overdue_loan_is_charged_nothing(service, clock):
    loan = service.checkout("kid", "B1")
    clock.set(date(2026, 3, 28))
    renewed = service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    assert renewed.due_on == date(2026, 4, 18)
    assert renewed.renewals == 1
    assert service.balance("kid") == Decimal("0.00")


def test_a_return_after_a_late_renewal_fines_only_days_after_the_new_due_date(
    service, clock
):
    loan = service.checkout("ann", "B1")
    clock.set(date(2026, 3, 28))
    service.renew(loan.loan_id)  # 1.25, now due Saturday 18 April
    clock.set(date(2026, 4, 21))  # Tuesday: Late days 20 and 21 April
    service.return_copy("B1")
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("1.75")


def _cheap_book(service, replacement_cost):
    service.add_title("978-9", "Pamphlet", Material.BOOK, Decimal(replacement_cost))
    service.add_copy("P1", "978-9")


def test_the_return_fine_is_capped_by_what_the_renewal_already_fined(
    service, clock
):
    _cheap_book(service, "1.50")
    loan = service.checkout("ann", "P1")
    clock.set(date(2026, 3, 28))
    service.renew(loan.loan_id)  # 1.25, now due Saturday 18 April
    clock.set(date(2026, 4, 25))  # six more Late days, 1.50 uncapped
    service.return_copy("P1")
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("1.50")


def test_a_renewal_fine_at_the_cap_leaves_nothing_to_fine_at_return(
    service, clock
):
    _cheap_book(service, "1.00")
    loan = service.checkout("ann", "P1")
    clock.set(date(2026, 3, 28))  # five Late days, 1.25 uncapped
    service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("1.00")
    clock.set(date(2026, 4, 25))
    service.return_copy("P1")
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("1.00")


def test_owing_a_renewal_fine_blocks_the_next_renewal_until_it_is_paid(
    service, clock
):
    loan = service.checkout("ann", "B1")
    clock.set(date(2026, 3, 28))
    service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("1.25")
    clock.set(date(2026, 4, 13))  # the window for Saturday 18 April is open
    with pytest.raises(AccountBlocked) as blocked:
        service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    assert blocked.value.action == "renewing"
    _assert_unchanged(service, loan.loan_id, date(2026, 4, 18), 1)
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("1.25")
    service.pay("ann", Decimal("1.25"))
    renewed = service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    assert renewed.due_on == date(2026, 5, 4)
    assert renewed.renewals == 2
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("0.00")


def test_a_renewal_fine_reaching_the_hold_limit_blocks_holds_straight_away(
    service, clock
):
    loan = service.checkout("ann", "B1")
    service.checkout("kid", "D1")
    clock.set(date(2026, 4, 15))  # Wednesday: 20 Late days
    service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("5.00")
    with pytest.raises(AccountBlocked) as blocked:
        service.place_hold("ann", "dvd-1")
    assert blocked.value.action == "holds"
    assert service.checkout("ann", "B2").member_id == "ann"


def test_a_renewal_fine_reaching_the_borrowing_limit_blocks_borrowing_straight_away(
    service, clock
):
    loan = service.checkout("ann", "B1")
    clock.set(date(2026, 5, 8))  # Friday: 40 Late days
    service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("10.00")
    with pytest.raises(AccountBlocked) as blocked:
        service.checkout("ann", "B2")
    assert blocked.value.action == "borrowing"


def test_a_refused_overdue_renewal_charges_nothing(service, clock):
    ann_loan, _ = _both_book_copies_out(service)
    service.place_hold("kid", "978-1")
    clock.set(date(2026, 3, 28))
    with pytest.raises(RenewalRefused):
        service.renew(ann_loan.loan_id)
    _assert_unchanged(service, ann_loan.loan_id, date(2026, 3, 23), 0)
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("0.00")


def test_an_overdue_dvd_renewal_charges_nothing(service, clock):
    loan = service.checkout("ann", "D1")
    clock.set(date(2026, 3, 14))  # five Late days on a DVD due Monday 9 March
    with pytest.raises(RenewalRefused):
        service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    _assert_unchanged(service, loan.loan_id, date(2026, 3, 9), 0)
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("0.00")


def test_an_overdue_renewal_over_the_allowance_charges_nothing(service, clock):
    loan = service.checkout("ann", "B1")
    for day in (date(2026, 3, 18), date(2026, 4, 3)):
        clock.set(day)
        service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    clock.set(date(2026, 4, 30))  # Thursday, due Friday 24 April
    with pytest.raises(RenewalRefused):
        service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    _assert_unchanged(service, loan.loan_id, date(2026, 4, 24), 2)
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("0.00")


def test_an_overdue_renewal_blocked_by_the_balance_charges_nothing(
    service, clock
):
    loan = service.checkout("ann", "B1")
    service.add_charge("ann", Decimal("0.01"), "lost library card")
    clock.set(date(2026, 3, 28))
    with pytest.raises(AccountBlocked):
        service.renew(loan.loan_id)
    _assert_unchanged(service, loan.loan_id, date(2026, 3, 23), 0)
    assert service.balance("ann") == Decimal("0.01")
